user.title: South West Water
user.description: Enter the username or email address you use to sign in to My Account on the South West Water website, plus your smart meter reference.

data_description.username: Whatever you type into the sign-in box on My Account: either your username or your email address.
data_description.meter_ref: The smart meter reference shown on your South West Water account.

tariffs.title: Tariffs & Charges
tariffs.description: Configure your South West Water charges. Pre-filled with standard metered rates. If you have a private septic tank or discount, you can adjust or zero out charges below. These can be updated anytime in the integration settings.

data_description.water_rate: Volumetric charge per cubic metre of clean water supplied.
data_description.sewerage_rate: Volumetric charge per cubic metre for wastewater (set to 0 if not on mains drainage).
data_description.water_standing_charge: Fixed daily service charge for clean water supply.
data_description.sewerage_standing_charge: Fixed daily service charge for sewerage (set to 0 if not on mains drainage).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your South West Water password is no longer accepted. Enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to South West Water.
